evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ and updates the generateblock RPC method arguments, help text, and client handling in src/rpc/mining.cpp and src/rpc/client.cpp.
rationale: The change removes a gap that forced downstream developers to manually build raw blocks for multi-output coinbase simulations. Review discussion confirms downstream demand for simulating multi-recipient coinbase payouts, but as an enhancement to regtest testing RPCs, it is reasonably deferrable.
